question: After rampage's trigger has resolved, does adding or removing blockers change the rampage bonus?

expected.shortAnswer: No: the bonus is calculated only once per combat, when the triggered ability resolves.
expected.answer: The rampage bonus is calculated only once per combat, when the triggered ability resolves. Adding or removing blockers later in combat won't change the bonus.
